guitar.modelsText: Gibson SG Special / Rickenbacker / Fender Stratocaster / Gibson J-200
guitar.evidence: Pete Townshend's Gibson SG Special (smashed on stage, used on Live at Leeds) and earlier Rickenbackers are extremely well documented; deserves high rather than medium confidence given how iconic his windmill/SG combo is.
guitar.notes: Upgraded confidence from medium to high.

tone.target: driven British crunch with tight bite
tone.profile: driven British crunch with tight bite
tone.summary: A classic British rock chain using a Boost for initial bite, Distortion for core crunch, an AC30 TB amp model, and a UK Vintage 4x12 cab to achieve the required midforward, ringing tone.
corrections: keep it more crunch than overdrive

rig.name: The Who - Pinball Wizard - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up high-gain noise inherent in crunchy rock tones.
Provide initial bite and tighten the attack for the 'ringing' effect.
blocks.gap: Using Boost instead of OD/Green OD to keep the tone focused on crunch rather than pure overdrive.

alternatives.reason: A solid alternative for initial drive, but Boost is cleaner for this specific 'bite' requirement.

blocks.purpose: Optional wah color and vocal sweep for added dimension.
blocks.gap: The requirement stated 'optional wah,' so this is included but kept subtle.

blocks.purpose: Establish the core 'midforward crunch' and sustain.
blocks.gap: Using general Distortion model to achieve a classic Marshall-style grit, avoiding deep fuzz or pure overdrive.

alternatives.reason: Could provide more aggressive bite, but 'Distortion' is safer for the Plexi vibe.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic British Plexi/Marshall sound profile.
Provide the necessary upper-mid frequency punch and British cabinet character.
Fine-tune the mid-range punch and tighten the overall tone.
Included as a potential subtle texture layer, but kept inactive to avoid conflicting with the 'crunch' focus.
blocks.gap: The verdict explicitly avoids chorus, so this is included only for completeness and can be bypassed.

blocks.purpose: Subtle rhythmic echo for added depth without muddying the crunch.
blocks.gap: Not strictly necessary, but a subtle delay can enhance the 'ringing' attack.

blocks.purpose: Add a touch of natural room ambience without the deep wash of plate/spring reverb.
blocks.gap: The verdict advises against 'deep reverb,' so this is kept subtle and controlled.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for better upper-mid punch and vintage British cabinet realism.

proposals.reason: Enhance the specific midforward, ringing bite required for The Who's sound.
